title: WAKMan: Workload Aware KVCache Manager
abstract: arXiv:2610.36355v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prefix caching enables a Large Language Model (LLM) servers to reuse the Key-Value (KV) states and accelerate prefill computation stage for requests that share a prefix with earlier prompts, thus reducing latency and serving cost. With limited memory resource, the KV cache eviction policy becomes a decisive factor in determining the overall benefits of prefix caching. Production traffic may have single-turn, multi-turn, agentic, or a mixture of any combination of these request types. Our findings indicate that agentic steps return within seconds and favor recency, while popular prompts and long conversations return after many other requests and favor frequency. Across 20 mixes, no single policy is always best: vLLM's default strategy LRU provides 12% higher cache hits as compared to the frequency-oriented S3FIFO on agentic-heavy mixes but trails it by up to 22% elsewhere, and even a single workload parameter can flip the winner even for

translated_title: WAKMan：工作负载感知的KV缓存管理器
translated_abstract: 前缀缓存使大语言模型（LLM）服务器能够重用键值（KV）状态，并为与先前提示共享前缀的请求加速预填充计算阶段，从而降低延迟和服务成本。在内存资源有限的情况下，KV缓存淘汰策略成为决定前缀缓存整体收益的关键因素。生产流量可能包含单轮、多轮、代理式或这些请求类型的任意混合组合。我们的研究结果表明，代理式步骤会在几秒内返回并偏向最近性，而热门提示和长对话则在许多其他请求之后才返回并偏向频率。在20种混合负载中，没有任何单一策略总是最优：vLLM的默认策略LRU在代理式请求为主的混合负载上比面向频率的S3FIFO提供了高12%的缓存命中率，但在其他情况下最多落后达22%，甚至单个工作负载参数就可能改变最优策略的选择……
tldr: 该论文提出了工作负载感知的KV缓存管理器WAKMan，通过分析不同类型请求（代理式请求偏向最近性、热门提示和长对话偏向频率）对缓存淘汰策略的不同需求，解决了没有任何单一淘汰策略能在所有LLM工作负载下始终保持最优的问题。
en_tdlr: WAKMan is a workload-aware KV cache manager that addresses the finding that no single eviction policy always performs best across diverse LLM serving workloads, since agentic requests favor recency while popular prompts and long conversations favor frequency.
